title: finding: `objectstack build --strict-body` miscounts — it prints "N callable(s) lack a metadata body" with one more than the callables it lists, because `--json` `issues` carries an aggregate pseudo-entry beside the real ones
body:
Filing gate **①**: user-visible misleading text at a public door, measured. **Class (a).**

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `marchtian` · session `session_01B5CHJNXuuqzChM4w6hkTN4`, from the #22810 dev's out-of-scope finding (`os-dev-report` `6109013472` on #22810, PR #22834). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The text is built in `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` (the `--strict-body` block), so a repair lands in `domain:cli` unless triage reads it otherwise.

## What is measured (by the dev, on a scratch app through `bin/run-dev.js`)

- With 4 refused handlers, `objectstack build --strict-body` printed `--strict-body: 5 callable(s) lack a metadata body`.
- With 1 refused handler (at the base `b7cd1af9df`), it printed `2`.
- `--json`'s `issues` carries an aggregate row beside the real callables.

## Why (read on `origin/main` `b7cd1af9df` by this seat)

`compile.ts` builds `issues` as the body-extraction warnings plus, when `missingBody > 0`, one aggregate row whose origin is a placeholder and whose reason is "N callable(s) lowered to handler ref but produced no body". It then prints `issues.length` as the count of callables (about `:335`–`:349`).

So the printed count is the real callables plus one. The machine-readable list carries a row that is not a callable.

## Expected (a shape for triage, not a ruling)

- The header counts callables only.
- `--json` `issues` lists callables only, or marks the aggregate as a summary, not as a callable.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included:
- `objectstack build --strict-body callables lack a metadata body count off by one aggregate issues entry` returned 10 hits, all closed and on other subjects. The nearest is #11529 (the build's 50-warning cap, closed).

Dedupe words: strict-body callable count off by one; lack a metadata body count aggregate; compile strict-body issues length aggregate row; --json issues aggregate pseudo callable.
